theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' q : ℕ) (G : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl m') (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') q) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) q) (N : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (s : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G → (∀ y ∈ N, (θ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) y = (ω (G y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G y)) → ∃ θs : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q, (∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (θs : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = (θ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) ∧ ∀ x : Eucl m, (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)) ∈ N → (θs : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x = (ω ((fun x : Eucl m => G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)))) x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (fun x : Eucl m => G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)))) x)
